title: [epic] RSS/Atom feeds — one feed per newsgroup
description:
Why: RSS and Atom feeds are the lowest-friction way to expose newsgroup content to the broadest possible audience. Anyone with a feed reader (Feedly, NetNewsWire, miniflux, etc.) can follow a group without a newsreader client, without JMAP, without IMAP. The overview store already has everything needed: subject, from, date, message-id.

What:
- Add feed endpoints to the mail HTTP server:
    GET /feed/<group-name>.rss  → RSS 2.0
    GET /feed/<group-name>.atom → Atom 1.0
- Each item/entry: title from Subject, author from From, published from Date, id from Message-ID, link to the web reader article URL (or the JMAP blob download URL for the full article).
- Pagination: ?limit=N&before=<message-id> for walking back through history.
- Content-Type: application/rss+xml and application/atom+xml respectively.
- ETag and Last-Modified headers for conditional GET support.
- Configurable max items per feed (default 100).
- No authentication required for public groups (auth policy tracked separately).
